description: Defines the CssOptimizer class for optimizing CSS assets within Drupal, including methods for cleaning, processing, and rewriting CSS files and URLs.

classes.name: CssOptimizer
classes.description: A class for optimizing CSS assets, including cleaning, URL rewriting, and handling @import statements.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the file URL generator dependency.

methods.name: optimize
methods.description: Optimizes a CSS asset if it is of type 'file' and preprocessing is enabled.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Removes multiple charset declarations from CSS contents for standards compliance.

methods.name: processFile
methods.description: Processes a CSS file, adds media queries, and rewrites relative URLs.

methods.name: loadFile
methods.description: Loads a stylesheet, resolves @import commands, and handles character encoding.

methods.name: loadNestedFile
methods.description: Recursively loads @imported CSS files and adjusts internal URL paths.

methods.name: processCss
methods.description: Processes CSS content for aggregation, cleaning, and optional minification.

methods.name: rewriteFileURI
methods.description: Rewrites relative URLs within CSS files to absolute URLs based on the base path.
